title: Area by Integrating with Respect to y
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the area enclosed by the curves x = 2 - y^2 and x = y.

steps.title: Find y-Intersection Limits
steps.mathExpression: 2 - y^2 = y \implies y^2 + y - 2 = 0 \implies (y + 2)(y - 1) = 0 \implies y = -2, \; y = 1
steps.explanation: Set horizontal coordinates equal to find y-limits.

steps.title: Identify Right and Left Curves
steps.explanation: The parabola lies to the right of the line.

steps.title: Integrate with Respect to y
steps.explanation: Evaluate the antiderivative between y = -2 and y = 1.
